logIn.title: Log In to Your Account
logIn.navigateToLogIn: Already have an account? Log In

forgotPassword.title: Reset Your Password
forgotPassword.messageEmail: Enter your email address below and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.resetEmailSent: A password reset link has been sent to your email. Please check your inbox and click the link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.resetSuccess: Your password has been successfully reset! You can now log in to your account.

signUp.title: Create Nutritionist Account
signUp.navigateToSignUp: Don't have an account? Sign Up
signUp.disclaimer: By signing up, you are creating a nutritionist account. This account will allow you to manage your clients and their nutrition plans. If you intended to create a client account, please install the mobile app and sign up there.

verifyEmail.title: Verify Your Email
verifyEmail.message: A verification link has been sent to your email. Please check your inbox and click the link to verify your email address.
verifyEmail.success: Your email has been successfully verified! You can now log in to your account.
verifyEmail.error: The verification link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new verification email.
